description: For engine plugins: sends the project's scenes (up to 20 per call) to the game's Inbox, matching by the engine id (externalId, e.g. res://units/spider.tscn). A scene that is already an entity only gets its image refreshed; a new one waits in the Inbox until the user places it in a tab on the site. Sending again never duplicates. Plugin flow, in order: sync_scenes (the plugin sends its scenes), game_scenes (see what arrived), place_scenes (turn them into entities), mark_installed (the plugin reports the install).

game_id.description: The game linked in the project (from list_games).

items.description: The scenes to send, up to 20 per call. Sending the same scene again never duplicates it.

description.description: Optional: what the thing is, so its sounds come out better. Up to 400 characters.

externalId.description: The scene path in the engine (e.g. res://units/spider.tscn): the key that matches it to an entity.

image.description: A thumbnail (PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 2 MB).

name.description: The scene name shown on the site. Up to 80 characters.

name: sync_scenes
title: Send engine scenes
